en.hubeali: Sahl, from Bishr Bin Bashhar Al Naeyshapouri who said, ‘I wrote to the manasws that the ones before us are differing regarding the Tawheed. So, from them is one who is saying, ‘Heazwj is a body’, and from them is one who is saying, ‘Heazwj is an image’

’. So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote to me: ‘Glorious is the One<sup>azwj</sup> Who can neither be limited, nor can He<sup>azwj</sup> be described, nor can He<sup>azwj</sup> be resembled with anything, and there is nothing Like Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and He<sup>azwj</sup> is the Hearing, the Seeing’.
